📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-09-03
1. OpenAI Says Upcoming Astra Model Has Reached 'Critical' Cybersecurity Capability模型
OpenAI宣布新模型Astra已具備重大網路安全能力
OpenAI announced its upcoming Astra model has met the "Critical" cybersecurity threshold in its Preparedness Framework, the first time any of its models has reached this highest risk tier. The model can independently discover and exploit zero-day vulnerabilities, or plan a full attack from a high-level goal.
OpenAI宣布，即將推出的Astra模型已達到《準備框架》中定義的「重大」網路安全能力門檻，是該公司首次有模型達到此最高風險等級，能自行找出並利用零時差漏洞，或依高層級目標自行規畫執行完整攻擊策略。
iThome · 原文連結
2. Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1 Opens Vulnerability Discovery to General Users模型
Anthropic Fable 5.1首度開放抓漏，仍禁止開發攻擊程式
Anthropic unveiled Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, easing safety guardrails to let general users apply Fable 5.1 to vulnerability discovery while still banning attack-tool development. Both share the same base model but differ in safety tier, supporting a 1M-token context.
Anthropic發表新一代旗艦模型Claude Fable 5.1與Mythos 5.1，首度對一般使用者放寬安全護欄，開放Fable 5.1用於發掘軟體漏洞，但仍禁止開發攻擊程式，兩者皆支援100萬token上下文。
iThome · 原文連結
3. Fei-Fei Li's World Labs Unveils Atlas, Ushering in a New Era of World Models研究
李飛飛發布Atlas，世界模型進入新時代
World Labs, founded by AI scientist Fei-Fei Li, launched its next-generation world model Atlas — an "omni-modal" model trained from scratch that natively handles text, images, video, and 3D data, set to power future versions of Marble and other products.
由AI科學家李飛飛創辦的World Labs發表新一代世界模型Atlas，這是一款從零開始預訓練的「全模態模型」，可原生處理文字、圖像、影片與3D資料，將驅動Marble等未來產品，標誌空間智能邁入新階段。
iThome · 原文連結
4. Google Releases Gemini 3.8 Flash, Its Third Flash Model in Six Weeks產品
Google發布Gemini 3.8 Flash，六週內第三款Flash模型
Google launched Gemini 3.8 Flash weeks after its predecessor, claiming it "works harder" by performing more reasoning steps and calling tools iteratively on complex tasks. Pricing stays at $0.75 per million tokens, same as 3.7 Flash, while Pro model updates appear paused.
Google在前代發布數週後推出Gemini 3.8 Flash，號稱新模型「更努力」，會在複雜任務執行更多推理步驟並反覆呼叫工具，定價與3.7 Flash相同，而Pro模型更新似乎暫停。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
5. Critical SQL Injection Flaw in Sangoma Switchvox Actively Exploited資安
Sangoma Switchvox重大SQL注入漏洞遭利用
Threat intel firm Horizon3.ai warned it reported 12 vulnerabilities in Sangoma's Switchvox VoIP platform back in April, the most severe being CVE-2026-9586 — an unauthenticated SQL injection flaw enabling remote code execution.
威脅情報公司Horizon3.ai警告，今年4月已向Sangoma通報12個Switchvox平台弱點，最嚴重的CVE-2026-9586可讓攻擊者未經身分驗證即透過SQL注入遠端執行任意程式碼。
iThome · 原文連結
6. curl 8.22.0 Released, Patching 10 Security Vulnerabilities資安
curl發布8.22.0版，修補10個資安漏洞
The open-source tool curl released version 8.22.0, fixing 10 vulnerabilities — 9 in curl/libcurl and one in wcurl — covering authentication bypass, memory safety, TLS certificate validation, and cookie handling issues.
開源工具curl發布8.22.0版，修補10項漏洞，涵蓋驗證繞過、記憶體安全、TLS憑證驗證與Cookie處理等問題，用戶應儘速升級。
iThome · 原文連結
7. Taiwan-Listed Chipmore Technology Hit by Ransomware, ERP Disrupted資安
上櫃公司創新服務遭勒索病毒攻擊，導致ERP等資訊系統無法運作
Taiwan-listed semiconductor equipment maker Chipmore Technology disclosed that some servers were hit by ransomware. It immediately isolated affected systems, but part of its systems, including ERP, remain disrupted.
上櫃半導體設備廠創新服務發布資安重訊，指部分伺服器遭勒索病毒攻擊，已啟動斷網隔離與應變機制，事故導致包括ERP在內的部分資訊系統無法正常運作。
iThome · 原文連結
8. 153 Million Driver's Licenses Found for Sale on New Dark Web Site資安
租車後數小時，我的駕照資料就出現在暗網待售
A journalist found their driver's license among 153 million records for sale on a newly launched dark web marketplace hours after renting a car. The FBI is reportedly investigating the breach as it continues to unfold.
一名記者在租車後短短數小時，發現自己的駕照資料已出現在一個新上線、兜售1.53億筆個資的暗網市場，據報導FBI正調查這起仍在擴大的外洩事件。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
9. Palo Alto Networks Paid $500M for Thrive-Backed Console, Sources Say產業
消息指出Palo Alto Networks以5億美元收購Thrive投資的Console
Palo Alto Networks reportedly paid $500 million to acquire Console, a startup backed by Thrive Capital. The deal leaves Sequoia-backed Serval as the de facto startup leader in AI IT service automation, industry watchers believe.
據知情人士透露，Palo Alto Networks以5億美元收購獲Thrive Capital投資的新創Console，業界人士認為此後Sequoia投資的Serval將成為AI IT服務自動化領域事實上的新創龍頭。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
10. Taiwan's Digital Ministry Releases Sovereign AI Evaluation: Models Must Understand Taiwanese Values政策
數發部AIEC公布主權AI評測結果，模型不只要懂繁中、社會環境，還要懂臺灣價值觀
Taiwan's Ministry of Digital Affairs released sovereign AI evaluation results for domestic and international general-purpose models, emphasizing that models must understand not just Traditional Chinese but also Taiwan's social context and values.
數發部公布AI產品與系統評測中心（AIEC）對國內外通用模型的主權AI評測結果，強調模型不僅要懂繁體中文，也要理解臺灣的社會環境與價值觀。
